title: Geometric duals of local cotangent spaces and their canonical maps
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and put $x=t(*)$, $R=\mathcal O_{X,x}$, $\mathfrak m=\mathfrak m_R$, $k=\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Define the geometric local tangent space to be $\operatorname{Hom}_k(\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2,\Omega)$, with its $\Omega$-vector space structure by multiplication of values. Equivalently it is the submodule of $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbb Z}(\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2,\Omega)$ of maps $\phi$ satisfying $\phi(rv)=\rho_t(r)\phi(v)$ for all $r\in R$ and $v\in\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$, where $\rho_t:R\to\Omega$ is the canonical local map of $t$. For a scheme morphism $f:Y\to X$ and $y\in Y$, define the cotangent map $\mathfrak m_{f(y)}/\mathfrak m_{f(y)}^2\to\mathfrak m_y/\mathfrak m_y^2$ by the actual stalk homomorphism, retaining its $\mathbb Z$-linearity; dual maps are precomposition.

lean.statement: def geometricLocalTangent {X : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) : Submodule Ω (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace (X.presheaf.stalk (t (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) →ₗ[ℤ] Ω)
